from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def fitres(extra_fn, feats):
    best=None
    for w0 in np.linspace(0.1,4,40):
        def r(p):
            B=np.column_stack([f for f in feats]+[np.exp(-p[0]*x**2)]+[np.cos(p[1]*t),np.sin(p[1]*t)])
            cc=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]
            return dv_dt-B@cc
        s=least_squares(r,[0.4,w0])
        rss=np.sum(s.fun**2)
        if best is None or rss<best[0]: best=(rss,s.x)
    return best
